title: Jacket Potatoes and Mushroom 'Meat'
subtitle: with Pear and Walnut Salad
description: Our veggie version of loaded jacket potatoes uses mushroom 'meat' cooked with onion and Tex-Mex spices. Pair with one of the great classics: pear and walnut salad.

steps.text: Cook potato: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Halve the unpeeled potato lengthwise and put, cut side down, in a microwave-safe dish (see Kitchen hack). Prick all over with a fork. Microwave, turning halfway, for 10 mins or until tender. Transfer the potato to the lined tray, cut side up, and drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil. Roast for 12-15 mins until golden.

Toast walnuts: Meanwhile, finely chop the onion. Put the walnuts in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan and wipe the pan clean. Heat 3 tsp olive oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 2-3 mins until softened.

Cook mushroom meat: Add the mushroom meat to the onion and cook, breaking up the lumps with a spoon, for 2 mins or until starting to brown. Add the Tex-Mex seasoning, 1 tbs barbecue sauce and 125ml (½ cup) water and cook, stirring, for 3 mins or until slightly reduced. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.

Make salad: Cut the pear into thin wedges. Coarsely chop the toasted walnuts. Combine 3 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the pear, walnuts and salad leaves and toss to combine.
Serve up: Divide the jacket potatoes among plates and top with the mushroom meat mixture. Serve with the pear and walnut salad and enjoy!
Kitchen hack: Microwaving the potato first reduces the roasting time. If you don't have a microwave, simply skip this step and roast the potato for 20-25 mins until tender.
